test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Indigenous
solution: The correct answer is **'Alien'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Indigenous** is an adjective which means originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native. (किसी विशेष स्थान पर स्वाभाविक रूप से उत्पन्न या उत्पन्न होना; देशी) • The meaning of the given options are as follows - • **Alien** - belonging to a foreign country. (विदेशी देश से संबंधित) • **Primitive** - relating to, denoting, or preserving the character of an early stage in the evolutionary or historical development of something.(किसी चीज के विकासवादी या ऐतिहासिक विकास में एक प्रारंभिक चरण के चरित्र को निरूपित, निरूपित या संरक्षित करना) • **Natural **- existing in or derived from nature; not made or caused by humankind. (प्रकृति में विद्यमान या व्युत्पन्न; मानव जाति द्वारा निर्मित या निर्मित नहीं) • **Innate **- inborn; natural. (जन्मजात) • From the above meanings it is evident that **alien **is the correct antonym for the word **indigenous**. 85:T888, ​The correct answer is **'****The captain announced that the flight would be delayed due to bad weather.'**
